artifact.self_contained_problem:
For integers $b$ and $c$, define the generalized central trinomial coefficient $T_k(b,c)$ as the coefficient of $x^k$ in the expansion of $(x^2+bx+c)^k$. For an odd prime $p$ and an integer $a$ with $\gcd(a,p)=1$, let $\left(\frac{a}{p}\right)$ denote the Legendre symbol. Prove or disprove the following two assertions for every prime $p>3$.

(1) One has
$$\sum_{k=0}^{p-1}\frac{\binom{2k}{k}T_k(3,-3)^2}{(-108)^k}\equiv\begin{cases}4x^2-2p\pmod{p^2},&\text{if }\left(\frac{-1}{p}\right)=\left(\frac{p}{3}\right)=\left(\frac{p}{7}\right)=1\text{ and }p=x^2+21y^2,\\[2pt]12x^2-2p\pmod{p^2},&\text{if }\left(\frac{-1}{p}\right)=\left(\frac{p}{7}\right)=-1,\ \left(\frac{p}{3}\right)=1\text{ and }p=3x^2+7y^2,\\[2pt]2x^2-2p\pmod{p^2},&\text{if }\left(\frac{-1}{p}\right)=\left(\frac{p}{3}\right)=-1,\ \left(\frac{p}{7}\right)=1\text{ and }2p=x^2+21y^2,\\[2pt]6x^2-2p\pmod{p^2},&\text{if }\left(\frac{-1}{p}\right)=1,\ \left(\frac{p}{3}\right)=\left(\frac{p}{7}\right)=-1\text{ and }2p=3x^2+7y^2,\\[2pt]0\pmod{p^2},&\text{if }\left(\frac{-21}{p}\right)=-1.\end{cases}$$

(2) One has
$$\sum_{k=0}^{p-1}\frac{(56k+19)\binom{2k}{k}T_k(3,-3)^2}{(-108)^k}\equiv p\!\left(\!\left(\tfrac{-21}{p}\right)+17\right)\pmod{p^2}.$$
artifact.status_search_result: Targeted searches for this specific conjecture (involving $\binom{2k}{k}T_k(3,-3)^2/(-108)^k$ and the binary quadratic forms $x^2+21y^2$, $3x^2+7y^2$) did not return any paper announcing a proof. Although several of Z.-W. Sun's supercongruence conjectures on generalized central trinomial coefficients have been resolved, no specific evidence of a proof of this particular pair of congruences was located, so its current status is unclear.

status_evidence.title: Reduction on the congruences of partial sums of P-recursive sequences
status_evidence.snippet: General methods to handle partial sum congruences of P-recursive sequences, related to many of Sun's open supercongruence conjectures.
status_evidence.claim: Several of Sun's supercongruences are still being addressed by general methods, indicating many remain open.

status_evidence.title: On a conjecture of Sun
status_evidence.snippet: Proof of one specific supercongruence conjecture of Z.-W. Sun.
status_evidence.claim: Sun's conjectures are resolved one at a time; no general proof of all his open conjectures of this type.
